notes.title: Notes
notes.deleteConfirmMessage: This note will be permanently deleted. Its todos will be detached, not deleted.
notes.description: A place for your ideas and checklists.
notes.noResults: No matching notes. Try another search.
notes.loadFailed: Notes could not be loaded. Your drafts are still here.
notes.welcome: Make room for your next idea
notes.welcomeDescription: Select a note or create one. Write freely, then save your title and body when you are ready.
notes.saveHint: Save title and body with Ctrl+S or ⌘S. Changes stay in this workspace until you leave.
notes.saveFailed: The save could not be confirmed. Your draft is preserved. Check the latest saved note before trying Save again.
notes.createFailed: Creation could not be confirmed. A note may already exist. Check All notes before trying Save again.
notes.deleteFailed: The note could not be deleted. Try deleting it again.
notes.deleteDraftWarning: Any unsaved edits to this note will also be discarded.
notes.leaveMessage: Your unsaved note drafts will be discarded when you leave this workspace.
notes.waitForSave: Wait for the current operation to finish before leaving.
notes.updatedExternally: This note changed elsewhere. Load the latest version or use Save to replace it with your edits.
notes.reloadWarning: Loading the latest version discards your unsaved edits to this note.
notes.deletedExternally: This note was deleted elsewhere. You can copy your draft, but it can no longer be saved to this note.
notes.copyFailed: The draft could not be copied. Select and copy the text manually.
notes.checklistHelp: Checklist changes save immediately and update the linked Todos.
notes.saveForChecklist: Save this note to add checklist items.
notes.toggleFailed: The checklist change could not be confirmed. Check its current state before trying again.
notes.checklistDeleteFailed: The Todo could not be deleted. Try again.
notes.addFailed: The checklist item could not be added. Your input is preserved; check the list before trying again.
